type Resource struct
  Handle string
  Digest string
  Size int64
  Verification Verification
type OpenResult struct
  Outcome OpenOutcome
  Resource *Resource
type Chunk struct
  Offset int64
  Total int64
  Data []byte
  EOF bool
type ReadResult struct
  Outcome ReadOutcome
  Chunk *Chunk
type CloseResult struct
  Outcome CloseOutcome
type Upload struct
  Handle string
  Digest string
  Size int64
  Received int64
type Stored struct
  Digest string
  Size int64
  Evidence Evidence
type BeginResult struct
  Outcome BeginOutcome
  Upload *Upload
  Stored *Stored
  Limit int64
type AppendResult struct
  Outcome AppendOutcome
  Received int64
type CommitResult struct
  Outcome CommitOutcome
  Stored *Stored
  Received int64
type AbortResult struct
  Outcome AbortOutcome
type Change struct
  Sequence int64
  Kind ChangeKind
  Digest string
  Size int64
type ChangePage struct
  Outcome ChangePageOutcome
  Changes []Change
  Next string
  AtEnd bool
type ListedObject struct
  Digest string
  Size int64
type ListingPage struct
  Outcome ListingOutcome
  Objects []ListedObject
  Continuation string
  Complete bool
  Cursor string
type Object struct
  Locator string
  Size int64
  Modified string
  Partial bool
  Digest string
  Evidence Evidence
type Entry struct
  Role string
  Digest string
  Size int64
  MediaType string
  Evidence Evidence
  Locator string
  Manifest string
  Annotations map[string]string
type Name struct
  Scheme string
  Name string
type Manifest struct
  ID string
  Addressing Addressing
  Kind string
  Entries []Entry
  Names []Name
  Descriptor map[string]string
  Store string
  SupersededBy string
type Holder struct
  Account string
  Program string
  Instance string
  EstablishedBy string
  Domain string
type Basis struct
  Index string
  Key string
  Role string
type Hold struct
  ID string
  Holder Holder
  Target string
  Purpose string
  Lifetime Lifetime
  Expires string
  Attestation Attestation
  ObservedAt string
  Basis *Basis
type Dangling struct
  Holder Holder
  Basis Basis
  Reference string
  ExpectedDigest string
  ExpectedSize int64
  ObservedAt string
type StoreError struct
  Kind StoreErrorKind
  Locator string
  Detail string
type Store struct
  Name string
  Program string
  Locator string
  Rule string
  Present bool
  Errors []StoreError
  Placement Placement
  Domain string
type HoldResult struct
  Outcome HoldOutcome
  Hold *Hold
type ReleaseResult struct
  Outcome ReleaseOutcome
type RenewResult struct
  Outcome RenewOutcome
  Hold *Hold
type DescribeResult struct
  Outcome DescribeOutcome
  Manifest *Manifest
type PublishResult struct
  Outcome PublishOutcome
  Manifest *Manifest
  Missing []string
type ManifestHolders struct
  Manifest Manifest
  Holds []Hold
type ObjectHolders struct
  Object Object
  Store string
  Holds []Hold
type InventoryPage struct
  Outcome InventoryOutcome
  Stores []Store
  Manifests []ManifestHolders
  Objects []ObjectHolders
  Dangling []Dangling
  Continuation string
  Complete bool
  Cursor string
  GraceMs int64
  AuditRetentionMs int64
type RemoveResult struct
  Outcome RemoveOutcome
  Holders []Holder
type SourceDescription struct
  Outcome SourceDescriptionOutcome

  Stores []Store
  Schemes []string
  Capabilities []string

  Sequence int64
  Kind SourceChangeKind

  Store *Store

  Cursor string
